lines.text: Hi guys! Honest review time. The food truck everyone is talking about.
I eat, I tell the truth, I give a number out of ten.
Nobody said anything about truth.
That is the whole thing, sir. Honest review.
I thought it said honest compliments.
It never said that. I have read the sign many times.
I'm Noodle. I come here every night. I am a regular.
He is a dog.
I am a regular dog. Those are different things.
Sal, the menu has one item. It says The Sal.
Correct. And there is a secret menu.
What's on the secret menu?
The Sal. But I say it louder.
Great. One Sal, please. Regular volume.
Psst. Order the lemonade. Nobody ever orders me.
Did that cup just whisper at me?
I am mostly tap water and hope.
That's the most honest thing ever said on this channel.
Okay, first bite, guys. Moment of truth.
Before you say anything, I've been doing this nineteen years.
My mother is watching. She has the internet now.
Mmm. Okay. Crunchy. Smoky. A little bit spicy.
So, ten.
Too much onion. Nobody listens to the dog.
You eat the napkins, Noodle.
And the napkins are excellent. Credit where it is due.
Okay, honest number for the taco. Seven.
Seven.
Seven is a number you give a parking lot.
Seven is good! Seven is a solid weeknight number!
I need to sit down. I don't have a chair.
Fine. One lemonade.
She said it! Somebody said it!
Spoiler. I am warm. I have been next to the grill since spring.
Lemonade gets a four.
A four. I will take it. My mother got a two.
Final score coming in three, two...
Wait. I am not just a regular dog.
I am the anonymous reviewer with the one-word reviews.
You wrote fine about the pizza place. They closed in a week!
It was not fine. I was being generous.
You've been coming here undercover? As a dog?
I am a dog. That is the cover. It is a very good cover.
Every night I give you the burnt ones out of pity!
I know. I wrote it down. Generous man.
Noodle, please. One word. A nice word.
The word is...
Home.
I am crying. I'm lemonade, so it's mostly the same.
Okay, final honest score for the truck. Eight out of ten.
Eight! Mom! We got an eight!
Minus one point for the lemonade.
Fair.
That's the honest review. Go see Sal. Bring a chair.
